The space
Spectacular Views of Reinefjorden - Excellent Sunlight
The house is surrounded by stunning natural beauty in the enchanting village of Reine, offering proximity to and breathtaking views of the sea and mountain ranges. The property is situated on the front row facing Reinefjorden.

The area provides incredible opportunities for exploration, whether on foot or by sea. From the property, it’s within walking distance to a grocery store and the popular mountain peak Reinebringen, which features a Sherpa staircase to the top. Reine also offers cozy cafés, charming restaurants, and a gas station for your convenience.
